description: When something is failing, get one work order for a service, file, or symbol: the recorded incident, likely cause chain, blast radius, governing policies, and divergences with provenance on each claim. Omit errorId for the latest incident or pin a specific one, then use expand/relate to verify the path.

errorId.description: Pin a specific incident by its id; omit for the most recent

nodeId.description: Graph node id the incident is on (service/file/symbol)

project.description: Project name when the core hosts more than one (set NEAT_PROJECTS=...). Omit to use the default project.

name: get_incident_card
